Lane rules:
1. Jeremy's instruction goes in exactly one lane. Split it if it touches two modules.
2. One active change per lane. Finish or pause before starting the next.
3. Cross-lane dependencies are written down, never silent.
4. verify_live.py is the gate — nothing is "done" until it passes.
5. Data staleness (lane 1) never blocks code fixes (lanes 2–4).
